reapack.name: ReaFL.lua
reapack.desc: ReaFL: FL Studio-style tools for REAPER

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20{\b\fs28 ReaFL}\par FL Studio-style tools for REAPER's arrange view.\par\par{\b Setup:} after installing, run {\i ReaFL - Setup (run once after install)} from the Actions list, then restart REAPER.\par\par{\b Tools:}\par\bullet Default (key 1): normal REAPER mouse behaviour.\par\bullet Mute (key T): left click an item toggles its mute, right click deletes it.\par\par{\b Requirements:} REAPER 7.03+; js_ReaScriptAPI (needed for the Mute tool's clicks; install it from the ReaTeam Extensions repository, which ReaPack includes by default); SWS recommended.\par Undo setup with {\i ReaFL - Uninstall setup}.\par}

version.author: Armaan
version.changelog: Initial release: tool modes with shortcuts (1 = Default, T = Mute) and a ReaFL toolbar. Mute tool: left click toggles an item's mute (selection untouched), right click deletes it.
